title: structure
description: Chapter structure of a bundle (structure.json): the ordered list of chapters and the page ids each contains. Frozen after first publish (DESIGN §4.3, §4.4).

chapters.description: Chapters in reading order. Chapters never share a page (DESIGN §6).

title.description: Chapter title as detected or edited (e.g. 'I', 'CHAPTER 1', or a book title for single-chapter works).

page_ids.description: Zero-padded 4-digit page ids belonging to this chapter, in reading order (e.g. ['0001','0002']).

items.description: A page id: zero-padded 4-digit sequence string.
